title: Small quasi-kernels in directed graphs
exact_target: Does every finite directed graph without sinks have an independent set of at most half its vertices reachable from every vertex within two steps?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3000079 (AMR-029-0079). CC BY 4.0.
H. Langlois, F. Meunier, R. Rizzi, S. Vialette and Y. Zhou, Quasi-kernels in split graphs (2024), Introduction, quasi-kernel definition and Conjecture 1, p.1.
